items.title: Henry "Pickle" Jackson Interview, 1961-08-09
items.q: Andy Quick, all those of them coming.

ctx.x: Yeah, there aren't very many big bands. There aren't many big bands. There aren't many big bands.
But at that time you had a lot of big bands. Sunset Royal, Entertainment, Jimmy Lutzfoot, Andy Quick, all those of them coming. Yeah, there were a lot of big bands at that time.
Were there any other early drummers that you can remember when you were a boy?
